name: brevity-node
description: Brevity-inspired micro framework for Node.js (TypeScript edition)

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @brevity/core && npm run build --workspace @brevity/plugin-cache && npm run build --workspace @brevity/plugin-debug && npm run build --workspace @brevity/plugin-viewer && npm run build --workspace @brevity/plugin-validation && npm run build --workspace @brevity/web && npm run build --workspace @brevity/views && npm run build --workspace @brevity/islands && npm run build --workspace @brevity/islands-svelte
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run docs:check
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && node --import tsx --test test/**/*.test.ts && npm run docs:check
scripts.publish:dry-run: npm run build:packages && npm pack --workspace @brevity/core && npm pack --workspace @brevity/plugin-cache && npm pack --workspace @brevity/plugin-debug && npm pack --workspace @brevity/plugin-viewer && npm pack --workspace @brevity/plugin-validation && npm pack --workspace @brevity/web && npm pack --workspace @brevity/views && npm pack --workspace @brevity/islands && npm pack --workspace @brevity/islands-svelte
scripts.publish:all: npm run build:packages && npm publish --workspace @brevity/core --access public && npm publish --workspace @brevity/plugin-cache --access public && npm publish --workspace @brevity/plugin-debug --access public && npm publish --workspace @brevity/plugin-viewer --access public && npm publish --workspace @brevity/plugin-validation --access public && npm publish --workspace @brevity/web --access public && npm publish --workspace @brevity/views --access public && npm publish --workspace @brevity/islands --access public && npm publish --workspace @brevity/islands-svelte --access public
